notes.title: Announcing The Final Bonus Case(s)!
notes.notes:
Hey Detectives! 

With Halloween almost here, I’m excited to announce the first ever, very special one-of-a-kind, three-in-one bonus case coming to [i]The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark[/i]! You’ll join fan favorite side characters from all throughout the series and solve these back-to-back anthology cases!

The Bloodwolves tackle a cryptic new threat from deep beneath the waves– all while trying to win  the championship pennant as a little league baseball team. Can Devon keep his mouth shut long enough to hit a home run? Can Emily refrain from using her baseball bat as a deadly weapon? Will Dooley coach these kids in the fine art of detective work to solve the case and win the big game? Not really! But it’s fun nonetheless.

The Brightside Division investigates the dangerous new drug kingpin taking over the criminal underworld of the Darkside. Streets flooded with heinous drugs, like dish detergent. Portals opening up to crazy alternate dimensions, like the beach! And a dark conspiracy to bring the magic of the Darkside to bear on everyone in Twin Lakes. Get to the bottom of this case with McScream and Ghoulie! 

Raxa watches in horror as her most valuable possession in the world is ripped from her very hands… A hacker has taken over every computer in Twin Lakes! But who could be behind this scheme in the shape of a pyramid? Detective McKing? El Doolio? Queen Cleopatra returned from the grave? Who can never be sure? You’ll need to download more RAM, delete system 32, and unfrag your hard drives by drilling a hole through them if you want to learn the answer!

I can’t wait to share more information on the cases in the future and dive into the mysteries in Darkside Detective!

-Riv Otter

notes.title: Play "One Flew Into the Cuckoo's Nest" Today!
notes.notes:
Hey, Detectives! 

[h2]New Case[/h2]

Welcome to another case for McQueen and Dooley in the quaint little city of Twin Lakes. This time, our intrepid detectives find a note saying they should head to the Twin Lakes Botanical Gardens. What could possibly be in store? Vegetarian werewolves? A mean, green mother from inner space? A space ghost on a trip coast to coast? 

None of those things! 

But if you want more information, you'll have to play a little Darkside Detective to figure them out! 

[h2]Chinese Localization[/h2]

Today's update also adds Chinese localization for the Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark! We've gotten A TON of feedback from chinese players that they'd love to play the game in their native language, so we're very happy to oblige them! 

[h2]Nigel Makeship Plush[/h2]

Alongside the release of the new case, we're also debuting the Nigel Makeship plush! Makeship is a crowdfunding site where you can pick up your very own Nigel the conspiracy theorist lake monster plush! The campaign isn't live right this second but [url=https://twitter.com/akuparagames/status/1513523336466382861]we are running a giveaway on Twitter[/url] if you're quick!

Here's how the campaign will work:

1) The campaign runs for three weeks!
2) Once we get 200 orders, the plushes get made!
3) Orders are only open during the campaign and can't be placed once it completes, so get them now!

The Nigel plush comes with a copy of the first game free, so if you're itching to find a way to introduce your friends to Darkside Detective, this is a spectacular opportunity. 

[h2]Buddy Gets Good: Nigel Makeship Stream and Q&A[/h2]

And if you want to have a little fun with the Makeship campaign and Nigel plush, come hang out in the [url=https://discord.gg/akuparagames]Akupara Games Discord[/url] on Monday, April 18th! I'll be streaming two Darkside Detective cases to the Discord and hosting a Q&A session with the folks at Makeship at 4PM Pacific/7PM Eastern! 

If you wanna learn how the Darkside Detective Twitter Adventure would end up becoming [i]One Flew Into the Cuckoo's Nest,[/i] we'll be answering that and other questions! 

Exciting times to be a Darkside Detective fan! We've got one more bonus case on the docket, so look out for it in the not-too-distant future. 

Happy hunting!
-Buddy

notes.title: Nominate The Darkside Detective: AFITD for the Labor of Love Steam Award!
notes.notes:
Hey, Detectives!

This year, I'm thankful I was able to save Officer Dooley from the Darkside Dimension, thankful I get to the robotic circus and thankful that I could see my favorite wrestler El Doolio.

And since I have the power to write a big ol' announcement for the Steam Awards, I'm writing a big ol' announcement for the Steam Awards! It's my pleasure to endorse [b]The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark[/b] for the [b]Labor of Love[/b] category, since we're definitely not in this for the money. For those of you who don't pay attention to the esoteric rules of the Steam Awards, players like you can nominate your favorite games for awards like Sit Back and Relax, Best Game You Suck At and Better With Friends. Each game can only win for one category, so we wanted to officially point you all in the direction of the [b]Labor of Love[/b] category and go "that one!" 

If you're sharing robotic turkey (this joke won't make sense 'til the next case is out, remember it!) with friends or family you're thankful for, might I recommend sharing [b]The Darkside Detective: A Fumble[/b] in the Dark with them as well? There's a Steam Sale starting right when this post goes live so it's never been a better time to show your family this game so they understand all the weird Bloodwolves references you keep making.

As always, thanks for playing and hope you have a great holiday!

-Buddy

P.S. If you wanna know why the cover image for this announcement is so garish and weird, that wasn't made by me. It was made by Miguel on the Twitter, blame him.

notes.title: Solve the Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark on April 15th!
notes.notes:
Hey, detectives!

 [b]The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark[/b] releases April 15th!

For $12.99, you'll be able to join the episodic, point-and-click adventures of Detective McQueen and Officer Dooley in six brand new cases! Travel to Castle Dooley in Ireland, a haunted vegan carnival, and even the dreaded high school reunion to get to the bottom of the irreverent cases the Darkside Division needs to solve. If you'd like a little taste of the action, why not take a look at our fancy new trailer?

[previewyoutube=WqGLQO9C31M;leftthumb]https://youtu.be/WqGLQO9C31M[/previewyoutube]

Twin Lakes is a cursed city. Less cursed than say, “Demons are tearing it apart” but more cursed than “always loses its keys” or “often steps in puddles”. It’s roughly in the middle of the cursed scale, is what we’re trying to say.

Cursed enough that it’s a nuisance. Cursed enough that somebody has to deal with it…

That’s where The Darkside Detective comes in. Whenever you hear a bump in the night, feel a tingle up your spine, or smell something fishy, Detective Francis McQueen isn’t far behind.

No, he doesn’t smell of fish - it’s a phrase, come on...

Picking up after the events of The Darkside Detective, McQueen has to save his usually-present (in body, if not mind) sidekick Officer Dooley from the Darkside, so the two can get back to what they do best - investigating the city’s many strange, often paranormal, always paradoxical goings-on.

Join them in this frighteningly funny point-and-click adventure as they investigate six more standalone cases bringing them to a carnival, the local retirement home, an amateur wrestling circuit and even as far away as Ireland as they do what they can to keep the Darkside at bay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33589632/23a3c603f3853c690cc6719ae7b6e8fe6c5c6bb2.gif[/img]

Features
● Six unique cases, the likes of which you’ve never seen before (not a guarantee)
● Uses both pointing and clicking technology
● Music from Thomas O'Boyle, a totally-living composer, definitely not undead
● Photo-Realistic* Pixel Rendering (*Depends on your definition of photo-realism)
● One mail-in rebate per customer on exorcism services for hauntings resulting from play

Wishlist The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark on Steam and Play The Demo Now!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/795420/The_Darkside_Detective_A_Fumble_in_the_Dark/

notes.title: The Steam Game Festival - We're in it!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33589632/93a794b194120cae6d9a4f8400220debdf4f451e.png[/img]

Greetings, you garish ghouls and gassy groupies.

In case you missed the news, the big Steam Game Festival is happening again! From February 3 to February 9, over 500 game demos and developer livestreams are being featured in the event, and that includes The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark!


[u][b]Dang, a demo![/b][/u]
If you've been itching to get your hands on the sequel to The Darkside Detective, there's no better time than now. For a limited time, you'll be able to play a free demo for The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark, giving you a chance to dive into the spirit-soaked adventures of Detective McQueen before the full game launches later this year!

And hey, if you're a streamer or YouTuber or TikToker or any other kind of -er and you decide to play the demo in a video or stream, tag us on Twitter @AkuparaGames and @SpookyDoorway and we'll share it with the whole spirit-sleuthing community.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33589632/23a3c603f3853c690cc6719ae7b6e8fe6c5c6bb2.gif[/img]

[u][b]Sweet, a dev stream![/b][/u]
Naturally, the only thing better than getting to [i]play[/i] the game is watching a bunch of the tired souls who made the game play it instead! On February 3 and February 6 we've got special developer livestreams happening here on Steam. You'll be able to catch some pixel-y sneak-preview goodness as we show off behind the scenes footage of the game, as well as special Code Coven gameplay walkthroughs with developers Traesa, Dave, and Paul!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33589632/6fe30fba054eac8aa4d65dfb949df3a109fc09bd.gif[/img]

For anyone who just tuned in, let me repeat - [b]the Steam Game Festival runs from February 3 to February 9![/b] We'll be showing off The Darkside Detective: A Fumble in the Dark all week, so if you want to fumble along with us, catch the event, hop in our Discord, and let's get ghosty.
